Following this tragedy, Walter learns about the financial disaster that has befallen his family due to his father’s investments in a failed mining company. This abrupt change in circumstance forces Walter to confront the realities of life and the necessity of earning his own way, setting the stage for his character's development and the various challenges he may face ahead.
